t: What Does The Name Deevan Mean?
s: Deevan is most commonly understood as a modern variant of Devan/Deven, names that ultimately trace to the Sanskrit deva, meaning “god,” “divine,” or “shining one.” In South Asian contexts, Devan (also spelled Deven, Deevan, Deewan) has long been used as a given name and sometimes as part of compound names (e.g., Devendra).
